notes.title: Happy Valentine's Day! Happy Lunar New Year 2024!
notes.content:
It's the Year of the Dragon! Soar through the skies amidst a dazzling display of fireworks and let the festive spirit warm your heart like a gentle lantern glow. Wishing everyone joy, prosperity, and good fortune all year long! Perhaps the celestial wisdom and power of this majestic creature is just what you need to guide your princess to the throne~ 

新年快乐！新年快樂！Happy Lunar New Year!

notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance 10/29-10/31 (Completed!)
notes.content:
Hello there everyone!

The Heart of Crown servers will be down for a planned server maintenance this weekend. There is no definitive end time for the maintenance, but we are expecting to finish on by end-of-day on 10/31 JST. 

During this time, lobby servers and other features will be unavailable. We apologize for any inconvenience. If the maintenance needs to be extended, we will post about it here.

[b]Update (11/1): [/b]Maintenance has been extended on 11/1 and may continue into this week.

[b]Update (11/1): [/b]Maintenance has been completed. All users will need to update to the latest Steam version in order to use the network interface. On certain PC configurations there are some unresolved issues related as state below, and we are still investigating and will continue to endeavor to resolve. 

- Some Windows Input and/or Locale Configurations result in double inputs in text fields. 
- Some network and/or firewall configurations may result in the Ranked Battle or Free Battle modes crashing the game upon input. 

If you experience these problems or any others with this new build please join [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/476420/discussions/0/3160957541901179445/]our discussion thread[/url] for the latest patch and we will do our best to analyze and create any fixes.

notes.title: Heart of Crown PC Game Night!
notes.content:
Hi there friends!

Culture Select is participating in the first-ever Steam Digital Tabletop Fest, an event celebrating games that cross the border between physical and digital.

Our deckbuilding title Heart of Crown PC is a perfect example of this: a re-creation of the physical “Heart of Crown” deckbuilding card game, taking advantage of all the benefits that digital has to offer!

To commemorate the occasion, we're holding an online meetup and game night for Heart of Crown PC on the official Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/PPVeN8R]https://discord.gg/PPVeN8R[/url]

Join us for some fun matches, to talk strategy, and to make some new friends! See you there~!Event 

[b]Starts at: 7:00 PM PDT~ on Sat. October 24th, 2020![/b]

notes.title: Japanime Digital!
notes.content:
Japanime Games has announced the launch of [b]Japanime Digital[/b]: a new imprint dedicated to bringing the great tabletop games from their extensive physical library to a wider, digital audience! 

As a valued partner in Heart of Crown PC, we've updated Heart of Crown PC's game information to reflect this new initiative. Look forward to some exciting new announcements in the years to come! Your support of Heart of Crown PC has been a big part of making this happen, and we'd like to extend a big thank you to everyone in the community!

For more details, check out the main Japanime Games website: [url=https://japanimegames.com/blogs/press/press-release-japanime-digital]https://japanimegames.com/blogs/press/press-release-japanime-digital[/url]

notes.title: 2019/11/09 - 2 New Language Versions of Heart of Crown!
notes.content:
From November 9th, Heart of Crown PC will be available in 2 new languages: Chinese and Korean! In anticipation of expanding our community, we invite everyone to come and find games on our Discord server.  

https://discord.gg/PPVeN8R

Please give a warm welcome to all new HoC players or join us if you haven't already!

This discount stacks with the sale, so if you've been waiting - now is the time to give Heart of Crown a try!

notes.title: Heart of Crown PC is on Discord!
notes.content:
Looking for a friendly match with other nobles or a safe place to plot your strategies for succession? Or just want to kick back in the village tavern after a hard day in the fields? The Official Heart of Crown Discord Server is now open!

https://discord.gg/GcYsy8R 

As a hub for the community, we’ll be organizing tournaments and events through this server, so look forward to it. Whether you’re a humble merchant or a mighty general, everyone is welcome! Join today!

notes.title: Retail Heart of Crown Compatibility!
notes.content: Are you a current Heart of Crown PC player from the retail Japanese release? Don’t fret, Steam and Retail editions are cross-compatible for online play! Note that in order for matching and online play to take place, all users must be playing the base edition of the game, as expansions have not yet been released for the Steam edition! Happy Heart of Crowning!
